label: Closed collections in the fixed actual esse-cause order
term: closed-collection rootedness of actual esse causes
definition: ClosedActualEsseCollectionsRooted p applies the existing CCR predicate to esseCauseGraph p at its singleton index. Both graph concreteness and existence select exactly InAct x p.esse, and its supplier-to-recipient grounds relation is exactly ActualEsseCause p. Every nonempty collection of these actual bearers closed under all distinct actual causes of its members contains a bearer with no such predecessor. The full cone of finitely reachable predecessors of any actual x is among the tested collections; the cone itself may be infinite.
note: Analyst adapter for #1639, attribution deferred. Dependencies: 8163859b-95b3-4dd2-8a69-541bd332f32f (actual cause of being), 38b9012a-472b-4544-a271-16d22b25c9ac (CCR), ea94e8dd-6f08-4099-9032-d302dd799a4e (finite root access), 183b48d2-1753-583d-aef9-4199cff86231 (represented essence), DEF-ESSE. This is a graph embedding, not an identification of mode-unspecified tenseless causation with independently supplied efficient, present-sustaining, constitutive or world-local grounding. The singleton index carries no modal assertion. No new primitive relation or borrowedness flag. It permits root-backed infinite chains and dependent cycles, excludes a detached rootless predecessor cone, and implies no asymmetry, uniform path bound or direct universal causation. Real application of the collective borrowed-actuality rationale to this entire selected relation and its supplier roster remains OPEN.
